notifications.text: Nightfall: civilians return to safe reachable camp work.
Retaliation: every surviving known portal releases an additional wave after10 seconds.
Main building damaged: paid repairs required; no passive health recovery.
Known left portal destroyed permanently; its barrier is now passable.
Paid wall repair paused: unsafe. Payment and completed work retained for replacement workers.
Insufficient personal carried money. Withdraw stash money explicitly before buying.
Waiting for equipment: hunter needs a bow and arrows from the stash.
Inventory full: destination footprint does not fit; no item moved.
Target unavailable: the selected corpse moved out of interaction range.
Save failed: previous successful save retained. Retry when storage is available.
Connection lost: reconnect to the same run; no new survivor or equipment created.
